name: com.hussienx.openxr-simultaneous-hands-controllers
description: Experimental, pending device verification. Enables XR_META_simultaneous_hands_and_controllers through Unity's OpenXR stack with no Meta SDK. Supports Windows Editor / Standalone (via Meta Quest Link) and Android (Meta Quest).

samples.description: Logs platform, active OpenXR runtime, controller and hand tracked states, simultaneous tracking status, and controller motion once per second.
